STUDY 148
Black Off-Shoulder Gown on the Street
Rights check
Source: 25029.jpg
Sleek, dramatic, elegant
WORKING NOTES
- The off-shoulder neckline and corset waist are the key shapes.
- Keep the brick building for a strong architectural backdrop.
Try this: Keep the brick building as an architectural backdrop.
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, straight dark
hair and rectangular glasses stands on a city street
in front of a red-brick building. She wears a fitted
black off-shoulder long-sleeve maxi dress with a
structured corset-style waist and a small heart
pendant. Her expression is calm and direct. Soft,
late-afternoon light and parked cars behind her.
Palette of black, brick red, and silver. Sleek and
dramatic, in the style of an evening street-style
photo.
